name: p3.5_alpha_sweep

params.embedding: post-hoc W* + alpha * P_K^T * S on the carrier (P3.2); BatchNorm statistics not recalibrated
params.alphas_note: fixed before running; no alpha selected here (P3.6)

wrong_keys.derivation: first N of P3.4's family, SHA-256('zk-crown/p3.4/wrong-key/v1' || u64 seed || u64 j)

params.accuracy: eval-mode top-1, per image; paired drop with exact McNemar and 95% normal CI (P2.5 method)
params.drop_definition: acc(reference) - acc(embedded); positive means the embedded model is worse

notes: One host, one key, post-hoc embedding without BN recalibration. Paired intervals cover image sampling, not training-seed or key-to-key variation. z is a scale, not a p-value (P3.7). No alpha selected (P3.6). Aggregates only; S, P_K, fingerprints and watermarked weights are not in this file.
